column1: # Irregular contractions: whole form<TAB>the words it expands to.
# Checked before the clitic rules in contraction_clitic.tsv, for forms whose
# stem is not what the clitic strips to ("won't" would give "wo", "shan't"
# "sha") or that expand to one word ("can't").
# "let's" (let us) is not here yet: expanding it moves the clean held-out
# figures (coverage 32.9 -> 32.8), so it waits for a reader rule that wants it.
